Round 10 (release 1.6.0) package notes, as written when each package merged.
Where a later package changed a value, js/data.js is the source of truth. Paths under E:/Temp name the build machine's evidence folders and are not part of the repo.
Commit ids and branch names in these notes are local build branches that are not published. P2 (the trade-off gates) did not merge; it moved to 1.7. Summary: ../r10-release.md
